map.光学元件质量合规检测 使用指南: Optical Component Quality Compliance Test User Guide
map.输入光学元件检测参数（表面质量/波前误差/面形精度/偏心/透射比），依据ISO: Enter optical component test parameters (surface quality / wavefront error / surface figure accuracy / decentration / transmittance) and automatically determine the quality grade and compliance against ISO 10110 and MIL-PRF-13830B.
map.综合评分 = Σ(各项评分 × 权重)；表面/PV/RMS/偏心/透射/等级/镀: Overall score = Σ(item score × weight); surface / PV / RMS / decentration / transmittance / grade / coating each 0–100, weighted
map.各子项按阈值映射到 0–100 分后加权求和，得到光学元件质量合规等级（A/B/: Each sub-item is mapped to 0–100 by threshold and then weighted and summed to give the optical component quality compliance grade (A/B/C).
map.按灵敏度/响应波段/暗电流选探测器。: Choose a detector by sensitivity / response band / dark current.
map.对比 Si/InGaAs/光电倍增管适用波段。: Compare the applicable bands of Si / InGaAs / photomultiplier tubes.
map.：可见光(400–1000nm)选 Si 探测器量子效率高；近红外 1310/1: : visible light (400–1000nm) favours Si detectors for quantum efficiency; near-infrared 1310/1550nm favours InGaAs; deep UV / single photon favours APD/PMT.
map.：信号电流 1μA、暗电流 0.1nA → 信噪比≈10⁴；暗电流大或带宽宽则噪: : signal current 1μA, dark current 0.1nA → SNR ≈10⁴; large dark current or wide bandwidth raises noise and calls for cooling or narrow band.
map.看响应度(A/W)与探测率 D*，弱光选高增益 APD/PMT，强光选线性 Si: Look at responsivity (A/W) and detectivity D*; choose high-gain APD/PMT for low light and linear Si for bright light.
map.制冷降热噪声、选小面积低电容器件、合理偏压，信噪比随之升。: Cooling reduces heat and noise; choosing small-area low-capacitance components and sensible bias raises the signal-to-noise ratio.
